segments.title: Cold Open & Hype Train Subscriber Alerts
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on; Hype Train runs chaotic subscriber acknowledgments with broken month counters after Streamer.bot migration; Case and Hype Train riff on Tim Walz VP announcement and Streets of Rage 2.

segments.title: Tim Walz VP Profile with Jeff Ripple
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins desk to read Wall Street Journal profile of Minnesota Governor Tim Walz (Harris VP pick); Biden audio glitches into silence; Case and Jeff discuss Walz's background, progressive record, and contrast with JD Vance; Trump/Adin Ross stream clips reviewed.

segments.title: Joe Rogan Brain Purge & Milk Monologue
segments.notes: AI Joe Rogan appears for 'brain purge' bit (oxygen deprivation valve); delivers extended surreal monologue about male lactation, caveman nipples, Jamie the dog eating batteries, Egyptian psychic magnets, and whisper-summoning moms named Kim.

segments.title: Diet Mountain Dew Allegiance: JD Vance vs Tim Walz
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate which VP candidate is the bigger Diet Mountain Dew fan; Munch claims Vance by default, Crum argues Walz reclaims the brand; chat poll flips to Walz, enraging Munch who declares heel turn.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Heavenly Bodies, Squid Game S2, The 4:30 Movie
segments.notes: Trent returns from hiatus with three trailers: 1984 aerobics thriller Heavenly Bodies, Squid Game Season 2 (Dec 2024), Kevin Smith's The 4:30 Movie; banter on Kevin Smith filmography and bisexuality in Chasing Amy.

segments.title: Trump Interview Clip & Pepito Cheese Frenzy
segments.notes: Case plays Trump clip discussing Zuckerberg call, Google censorship, and Fox News reach; Pepito storms desk for cheese, triggering Hype Train closing rap about GOP and 'smooth link'.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors full broadcast; manages broken alert system, moderates Walz/Vance discourse, triggers Joe Rogan bit, oversees Munch & Crum and Trent segments.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open sign-on; reappears at stream end for cheese-fueled energy sprint across desk.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype correspondent. Runs subscriber alerts with glitched month counts; freestyles Streets of Rage 2 rap; closes show with GOP rhyme.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Joins news desk to read Walz profile; banters on Biden glitch, JD Vance couch jokes, and bull-sperm beard regimen.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues Tim Walz is the true Diet Mountain Dew champion; wins chat poll but refuses to accept loss gracefully.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Claims JD Vance owns Diet Mountain Dew brand; melts down when chat poll favors Walz, threatens heel turn.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: film correspondent. Returns for Trent at the Movies after absence; presents three trailers with horny commentary on Heavenly Bodies.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Present in studio watching Love Island; reacts vocally but does not speak on mic.

lore_notes.fact: Subscriber alert month counters broken after Streamer.bot migration, showing multiple conflicting values (0/18/19/20/21/24 months).
Uncertain of exact streaming tenure; chat votes tie between 69 years and 0 months as duration.
Exhibits cheese-dependent energy spikes; rushes desk at stream end after cheese consumption.
Claims to have lung valve for 'brain purge' oxygen deprivation sessions; asserts cavemen produced 5x more milk than women via long nipples looped as camel packs.
Declares heel turn after losing Diet Mountain Dew poll to Tim Walz; claims 'wise wolves' minority will prevail.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers the Harris-Walz ticket announcement with a Wall Street Journal profile read by Jeff Ripple, then reviews Trump's appearance on the Adin Ross stream. An AI Joe Rogan delivers a surreal 'brain purge' monologue on male lactation and Egyptian magnet magic. Munch and Crum clash over Diet Mountain Dew loyalty in a debate settled by chat poll for Tim Walz, prompting Munch's heel turn threat. Trent returns for a movie trailer segment featuring 1984's Heavenly Bodies, Squid Game Season 2, and Kevin Smith's The 4:30 Movie. The broadcast closes with a Trump interview clip and a cheese-fueled Pepito sprint.
